fusion_spec.query: temporal bottleneck projection + region embedding + detached proposal position/rotation-6D
fusion_spec.proposal_pose: existing window-world positions (m/2) and local rotation columns (residual-6D + identity); temporal bin mean; no FK
fusion_spec.global_local_attention: separate; region-ordered shared fusion; additive hidden updates
fusion_spec.local_keys: normalized raw region context + region embedding + validity-pooled proposal position/rotation-6D projection
fusion_spec.global_gate: validity only; independent of local alpha_bar_squared gate
fusion_spec.empty_policy: per-branch evidence mask; bias-free final map gives exact identity
fusion_spec.query_pose_pool: uniform native-valid window frames; no GT frame weights
fusion_spec.normalization: LayerNorm query/global K-V/raw local context/composed local K-V; affine defaults
